title: Mur Pano language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Papua New Guinea
extract: Mur Pano, or simply Pano, is an Austronesian language spoken by about three quarters of the thousand inhabitants of Mur village on the north coast of Madang Province, Papua New Guinea. The other quarter of the population speaks Molet as their primary language.
